source_facts.title: Material properties enter a solver interface
source_facts.fact: YAML properties include heat capacity, conductivity, phase thresholds/targets and fractional secondary products. ElementLoader filters by mounted DLC substance tables and manifests them into elements; SimMessages builds the native table. Brine specifies a steam transition plus30percent salt.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Original materials can distinguish retained quantity, state and usable function; a named material bonus is less expressive than a rule reaching a later process.
source_facts.bound: Native pressure, heat diffusion and phase solver equations were not recovered or semantically read.

source_facts.title: One limiting recipe input scales real conversion
source_facts.fact: ConvertMass computes a common available-input factor, removes actual storage mass, carries disease proportions and derives heat-capacity-weighted input temperature before creating stored or emitted outputs.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Commit a frozen owned batch once, including useful output, residue and its physical consequences.
source_facts.bound: Selected converter methods; not every recipe, mod or machine.

source_facts.title: Oxygen production is also heat and power
source_facts.fact: Electrolyzer config consumes 1 kg/s water, emits 0.888 kg/s oxygen and 0.112 kg/s hydrogen with 343.15 K minimum output, requires 120 W and sets a 1.8 kg per-cell mass ceiling. Its pressure check searches a bounded neighboring region; overpressure deactivates operation until support returns.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Preparation can choose fuel, ventilation and useful byproduct custody rather than only a success percentage.
source_facts.bound: Numbers describe this pinned config; no game run or heat-equilibrium proof.

source_facts.title: Pipes keep material identity and payload
source_facts.fact: ConduitFlow.AddElement rejects an occupied segment containing another element, limits admitted mass, blends temperature and disease; RemoveElement returns a proportional payload and leaves the rest. Versioned contents migrate and invalid temperature resets on load.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Carried fluids and cargo must retain exact owners, amounts and relevant quality through transfer and load.
source_facts.bound: Selected admission/removal/load branches; routing and phase rupture not exhaustively traced.

source_facts.title: Power converts owned fuel into work and waste
source_facts.fact: EnergyGenerator validates all recipe fuel for the tick, consumes it, emits outputs and generates joules. CircuitManager allocates generator/battery energy to actual consumers and connection status.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Shared facilities can compete for an actual finite energy owner without a second resource bar.
source_facts.bound: All circuits and power-building formulas not read; battery threshold delivery is not claimed to halt every generator.

source_facts.title: Overload has accumulated failure and recovery
source_facts.fact: ElectricalUtilityNetwork accumulates overload time above supported wire capacity, damages a wire after6seconds, shows a notification and decays overload time below the threshold.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Allow an original prepared system to fail through disclosed capacity strain and leave repairable aftermath.
source_facts.bound: Selected overload function; complete repair/destruction process unread.

source_facts.title: Breathing chooses a provider, not a body-wide immunity
source_facts.fact: OxygenBreather chooses a usable provider, consumes according to actual air rate and dt, emits/stores CO2 according to provider and reports actual consumption. World gas provider samples nearby breathable cells and submits native consumption with a result callback.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Separate environmental availability, reserve ownership and usable support in an expedition.
source_facts.bound: Native exact gas-flow solver remains opaque; suit provider internals not fully read.

source_facts.title: Oxygen shortage interrupts work before death
source_facts.fact: BreathMonitor changes urge and recovery chores, including reserved underwater breathing locations. SuffocationMonitor drains breath, moves to incapacity with a120second default countdown and permits recovery before its DeathMonitor kill call.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: A source-specific warning, retreat and rescue window can be meaningful without adopting lethal background loss.
source_facts.bound: DeathMonitor and all rescue chores not completely traced; source countdown is not a YAIR balance choice.

source_facts.title: Body temperature differs from ambient comfort
source_facts.fact: WarmBlooded has simple production, homeostasis and homeostasis-without-calorie-impact modes using body mass and heat capacity. TemperatureMonitor smooths actual body temperature and drives warm/cool urges from thresholds.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Body support profiles should declare conversion and recovery costs separately from weather labels.
source_facts.bound: Environment exposure/damage and every body species were not fully reviewed.

source_facts.title: Hunger is a scheduled physiological urge
source_facts.fact: CalorieMonitor distinguishes hungry/starving/depleted values; meal schedule controls ordinary hunger urges while starvation/depletion escalates. Depleted sets a body tag.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Ordinary rest/work conflicts can be modeled from actual condition and timing rather than a universal labor tick.
source_facts.bound: Final calorie-depleted DeathMonitor consumer unread; no full starvation death claim for duplicants.

source_facts.title: Aptitude, mastery and trainable attributes differ
source_facts.fact: MinionResume separately persists aptitude, learned/granted skills and experience. AttributeLevels separately saves per-attribute level/XP and refuses gain when maxAttributeLevel is0; BionicMinion config uses that0cap.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Distinguish an innate aptitude, training, granted tool competence and retained learning.
source_facts.bound: All trainable attributes/perks and formulas unread; not evidence of a universal talent system.

source_facts.title: Morale is a warning rather than a mastery veto
source_facts.fact: Mastery conditions include stress warning, aptitude, inability, points and prior skill. CanMasterSkill vetoes inability/points/prior skill, not stress warning. Learned non-granted skills add expectation by tier; aptitude adds morale.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Expose consequential soft warnings separately from hard action requirements.
source_facts.bound: Selected predicate/expectation methods; no claim that all UI warning behavior was exercised.

source_facts.title: Eligible labor depends on people and reach
source_facts.fact: ChorePreconditions consults permission/assignment, learned perks, schedule, navigation, pickup privacy and priorities. Red alert can override the schedule predicate; reach contributes cost.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Reserve actual consenting workers, attention and sites, with explicit emergency policy and no magical global queue.
source_facts.bound: Consent is an original YAIR requirement; source permission is not a claim of human consent.

source_facts.title: Research spends material during real labor
source_facts.fact: ResearchCenter subscribes to ElementConverter consumed mass, keeps fractional-point remainder and adds typed points; active work sets speed, while stop deactivates work. Faster qualified workers can preempt before completion.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: A research job can consume owned samples in stages, leave progress and compete for a qualified worker.
source_facts.bound: Partial progress cancellation is source-specific; do not impose its policy on YAIR frozen refund jobs.

source_facts.title: Research branches share explicit point domains
source_facts.fact: Research queues prerequisites, selects active tech, warns about missing advanced/space/nuclear/orbital researcher perks, purchases only after affording all typed costs and records progress/POI unlocks. Missing point types are added on deserialize.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Acquisition, learned theory, practical facility access and usable unlocks can remain distinct domains.
source_facts.bound: All tech definitions/build-menu unlock consumers and research types are source-accessible unread.

source_facts.title: Specialization has a welfare cost downstream
source_facts.fact: QualityOfLifeNeed computes difficulty-dependent stress penalties or relief from morale versus expectation. StressMonitor crosses60/100 tiers subject to stress-break setting; StressBehaviourMonitor substitutes response chores and reprieve states.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: An original worker may accept a specialty yet require a funded rest/support plan; temporary stress does not rewrite lasting willingness.
source_facts.bound: Concrete destructive/eating/crying stress chores and social relationship systems unread.

source_facts.title: Plant habitat and inputs gate growth
source_facts.fact: Mealwood config has temperature/atmosphere/pressure/drowning rules and dirt consumption. WiltCondition enumerates environmental/nutritional conditions; Growing stalls on wilt/custom condition and separates wild/planted rates.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: An optional original crop can use current habitat and paid husbandry to determine practical yield.
source_facts.bound: Not a full plant catalogue, complete wilt-delay review or ecosystem solver.

source_facts.title: Plant nutrients may be alternatives
source_facts.fact: PlantElementAbsorber.PlanConsume with an array returns after the first consumable tag succeeds, clearing commands between choices. ElementConverter instead checks every active required input.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Content must say whether feedstocks are alternatives or jointly required; one recipe abstraction cannot silently choose.
source_facts.bound: Selected helper semantics, not every plant absorber caller.

source_facts.title: Harvest produces a physical output
source_facts.fact: Crop spawns a configured output with actual yield and plant temperature, may roll a mutation through SeedProducer, and records created calories. Growing can auto-harvest an aging ready crop before resetting maturity.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Keep output, seed/renewal and one-shot story completion separate; never auto-replant the existing finite YAIR crop.
source_facts.bound: Mutation-roll implementation and complete crop renewable catalogue unread.

source_facts.title: Ecological output depends on actual diet
source_facts.fact: CreatureCalorieMonitor stores diet-qualified consumed calories and converts them to species-specific material output and optional disease/solid tiles. Tame out-of-calorie state can kill after its timer; wild hungry state differs.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Biological production can consume real feed and produce useful, possibly contaminated material rather than generic income.
source_facts.bound: Diet definition catalogue, predators and population-wide ecology unread.

source_facts.title: Hunger pause is a defined exception
source_facts.fact: Creature hunger can be paused; starvation start time is recalculated on unpause. Starvation uses GameClock while minimum meal-to-poop delay uses Unity Time.time.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Name each clock and exception explicitly; region absence, pause, render time and physiology cannot be treated as one policy.
source_facts.bound: These functions do not establish browser-closed, offline or every offscreen-world behavior.

source_facts.title: Reproduction is not a fixed free spawn
source_facts.fact: Fertility depends on paused/blocked tags, saved normalized breeding weights and cycle-based fertility. Laying resets fertility and creates an actual egg, copying wildness; modifier functions can change breeding chances.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Distinguish lifecycle, inherited tendency, habitat support and born output custody in original ecology.
source_facts.bound: Modifier catalogue, egg incubation and all species/late-game variants unread.

source_facts.title: Colony cycle and played time are separate
source_facts.fact: GameClock adds simulation dt, carries each600seconds into a cycle, emits cycle events/autosaves and separately counts render-played time. Old time can be migrated into cycle/time components.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: YAIR should keep one authoritative played clock and explicit region leases, never infer offline hazards from this source clock.
source_facts.bound: No closed-game or global time-control inspection.

source_facts.title: Save contains native cells and managed objects
source_facts.fact: SaveLoader serializes root/settings, native Sim save bytes, SaveManager and Game state. Load rebuilds element tables, validates native world load and reads managed state; active DLC checks use the save context.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Persist rules/state independently of graphical nodes while keeping definitions/version and DLC capability gates explicit.
source_facts.bound: Source code inspected only; no actual save/profile read or save/reload run.

source_facts.title: A save API is not an atomic durability proof
source_facts.fact: SaveLoader first constructs memory contents, then opens the target with FileMode.Create and writes headers/compressed data; permission/IO failure reports a dialog and returns the active save path. No temp-file atomic replace appears in the inspected method.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Retain YAIR durable publication and failure handling rather than copying this source write pattern.
source_facts.bound: Selected file-writing method, not a platform-wide storage reliability claim.

source_facts.title: DLC access has distinct gates
source_facts.fact: DlcManager maps five gameplay packs plus cosmetic pack, checks subscription and content settings; prefab requirements/forbidden lists and SaveLoader active-save restrictions are separate. Element loading also needs a mounted substance table.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Author capability availability, current-world rules and ownership separately.
source_facts.bound: No subscription/setting API called; installed depots do not verify account ownership or enabled saves.

source_facts.title: Interworld travel pays from real tanks
source_facts.fact: Clustercraft travel depends on rocket-space/resource checks. BurnFuelForTravel withdraws tank fuel and qualified oxidizer per traveled step, and consumes robot-pilot databanks where present. ClusterTraveler stops if unable to travel, validates steps and reveals fog.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: A journey should bind cargo, range, pilot/control, reachable destination and changed arrival conditions.
source_facts.bound: Launch-readiness delegates, all engine modules, landing/support and rocket-interior physiology are not fully traced.

source_facts.title: Cold feedstock changes the heating cost
source_facts.fact: IceKettle gates batch mass, output capacity and fuel. Its equation uses solid mass, heat capacity and initial-to-target temperature difference; completion removes ice/fuel, emits water and exhaust. Collection transfers actual liquid through a separate workable.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Current batch condition can alter exact process costs and leave a usable output and byproduct.
source_facts.bound: This simplified game formula is not physical latent-heat science; recipe balance is not a YAIR default.

source_facts.title: Restored infrastructure has discovery and real throughput
source_facts.fact: Geothermal repair fetches1200kg steel and a reconnect chore consumes stored repair inputs. Heat-weighted feedstock outputs include92percent passthrough, temperature-qualified impurities and recursive phase/byproduct splitting; vents receive divided output then input storage is cleared. Discovery/repair/vent aftermath is retained.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: A found facility can become a genuine material service with repair rights, throughput and later failure rather than an achievement-only toggle.
source_facts.bound: Full geothermal vent damage/pipe failure, all impurities and discovery UI sequence unread.

source_facts.title: Bionic bodies replace several ordinary needs
source_facts.fact: Bionic prefab adds actual battery/upgrade/oxygen storage and separate battery/oil/gunk/tank/water monitors, has no normal breath-recovery ability and uses calorie-free homeostasis. Tank consumes actual breathable material and seeks refill under safe/low/critical states.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: A future original vessel needs its own sustain and recovery functions; mechanical body is not blanket hazard immunity.
source_facts.bound: All bionic baseline traits/gunk/disease/resurrection edge cases unread.

source_facts.title: Battery depletion creates a rescue dependency
source_facts.fact: BionicBatteryMonitor tracks real internal/bank charge; offline toggles incapacity, enables delivery and invokes reanimation work once charged banks arrive. Oil depletion chooses different penalty according to EfficientBionicGears perk.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Fuel supply, immobilization, maintenance skill and willing repair help can form separate practical choices.
source_facts.bound: Exact full recharge economy and all station/portable-bank definitions unread.

source_facts.title: Water protection is conditional
source_facts.fact: Bionic water stress tests AnyWater liquids, airtight suit protection and feet protection/depth exceptions. It applies a stress effect and reaction, not generic immunity/death in this monitor.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: State precisely what a boot/lining protects, which depths exceed it and which body function remains vulnerable.
source_facts.bound: All liquids/body effects and downstream stress definitions unread.

source_facts.title: Installed competence can be reversible and powered
source_facts.fact: Bionic upgrades distinguish assigned versus installed slots, lock/uninstall behavior and wattage modifiers. BionicUpgrade_Skill grants a skill on enter and ungrants on exit; MinionResume treats granted skills separately in morale expectation.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: An equipped borrowed tool can grant execution while retained practice remains earned history; return/removal should remove only support.
source_facts.bound: Not every booster/slot unlock or stacked skill-grant edge case.

source_facts.title: Remote work retains a real operator
source_facts.fact: RemoteWorker resolves attributes/converters from the terminal worker. Its state machine separates controlled work, uncontrolled docking/maintenance, unreachable-depot incapacity and missing-depot destruction.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Remote operation should spend an actual operator and target support, not clone a mind or grant free autonomous work.
source_facts.bound: Full terminal operator reservations, remote power/gunk/oil spending and network topology unread.

source_facts.title: Impactor failure and victory leave different worlds
source_facts.fact: LargeImpactorEvent creates or restores an event target, follows arrival or death, records landed cycle versus defeated state, and can trigger an iridium shower after interception. Target destination/arrival are serialized.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: An authored environmental crisis can have warning, paid defense, failed impact and continuing-life aftermath, without erasing the world.
source_facts.bound: Impact damage/crater sequence, all generation conditions and weapon damage statistics unread.

source_facts.title: Defense spends an actual ammunition entity
source_facts.fact: MissileLauncher separates local and long-range stores, finds the active impactor target and launches a detached stored projectile, clearing the long-range target after the shot. Peat generator joins another real fuel/power/dirty-water/CO2 recipe.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Defense must compete with useful industrial resources and reserve a actual action, not just set a protection flag.
source_facts.bound: Projectile travel/damage and every defense recipe unread.

source_facts.title: Swimming ability reaches navigation and recovery
source_facts.fact: SwimMonitor reads the CanSwim perk on role changes, alters relevant stamina modifiers and suit penalties. BreathMonitor can reserve a reachable underwater breathing station and perform a recovery chore.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Learning a capability should unlock a concrete path/action while retaining air/recovery needs and equipment costs.
source_facts.bound: Nav-grid construction, complete swimming damage and marine creature breathing capacity unread.

source_facts.title: Environmental power is coupled to a source cycle
source_facts.fact: ReefGenerator config requires DLC5, a gasket material and geyser attachment. Its operational states link to that geyser and enable wattage during exhale, disable it during inhale.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: A renewable service can depend on a current source cycle and actual site support rather than infinite automatic production.
source_facts.bound: All aquatic recipes, geyser ecology, solitary recruit and rubber production are source-accessible unread.

source_facts.title: Grant removal shares the mastery mutation
source_facts.fact: MinionResume.GrantSkill records the skill in both mastery and GrantedSkillIDs; UngrantSkill removes the granted IDs and calls UnmasterSkill. This inspected branch is not proof that removing a booster preserves a separately learned copy.
source_facts.original_yair_implication: Keep earned competence and borrowed execution support in separate owners; removing equipment must remove its contribution without erasing earned learning.
source_facts.bound: This direct branch was read; complete multi-grant and previously mastered scenarios were not exercised.
